- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f0be24aea183983d4ad66b8c3094b52d3d8a511`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts + packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/liveness/object.json, packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.test.ts, packages/spec/src/data/index.ts, packages/spec/tsup.config.ts, packages/spec/package.json, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, docs/adr/0085-object-semantic-roles-over-surface-hint-blocks.md, .changeset/23964-record-surface-docblock.md, .objectui-sha, and objectui at the pin f8267df9: packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts, packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx, packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx

Inputs: card #23964 (body, triage 6219556949, claim 6222996144, dev report 6223669341); PR #24035 (body, file list, the net diff of the head against its merge-base with main, fd0e72abc2: one commit, two files, +34/-14); the head's check-runs, read at 2026-10-16T20:29Z: 40 runs, 32 success, 6 skipped, 2 still in progress (Test Core 2/6 and 3/6) — those two this record has not read; the other four Test Core shards, Build Core, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard and every Lint and Type Check run are success. Reviewer: the contract-review subagent of domain:spec seat 1, in that seat's session (the Reviewed-by line). Read-only: no checkout, build, test or gate run; the rest of the diff (the changeset) is judged here only as the semver carrier under ②.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff to record-surface.ts is 38 changed lines, every one inside the two block comments (the file header at :3-:32 and the deriveRecordFlowSurface docblock at :128-:163); zero changed lines outside a comment. No `.zod.ts`, no accept-set, no export moved; api-surface/data.json and export-origins/data.json still name both functions at the same origin. Confirmed.

Each sentence the diff adds or changes, against the code it describes:

File header, :4-:12 (not shipped):
1. "the single source for how an object's create / edit / detail record opens by DEFAULT. ADR-0085 §5" — right; §5 is "One shared derivation, every surface".
2. "The size axis comes from the record's weight (deriveRecordSurface: field-heavy or mobile → 'page', otherwise a side drawer)" — right: :96 mobile → 'page', :98 count at or above the threshold → 'page', :99 'drawer'.
3. "viewing a record: a routed full page when field-heavy (or on mobile), otherwise a drawer" — right: :170-:172 routes only when the base surface is 'page', else an overlay carrying 'drawer'.
4. "creating / editing one: always an overlay — a modal when field-heavy (full-screen on mobile, bounded on desktop), otherwise a drawer" — WRONG on one cell. "always an overlay" and the modal's size split (size 'full' on mobile, 'auto' on desktop, :177) are right; the condition is not. The base surface is 'page' when field-heavy OR on mobile (:96), so a LIGHT record on MOBILE is a full-screen modal, not a drawer (:176-:177; the inline comment at :173-:175 says exactly that; record-surface.test.ts :105-:116 pins "task flows, light or heavy, become a full-screen modal"). The view bullet spells the mobile arm out ("or on mobile"); this bullet drops it, so "otherwise a drawer" reads as the mobile-light answer, and that answer is false. One-phrase fix: "a modal when field-heavy or on mobile (full-screen on mobile, bounded on desktop), otherwise a drawer".

File header, :14-:24 (not shipped):
5. "ADR-0085 §2's admission test rejects per-surface presentation toggles on the object: the size of the surface is not a business fact a machine cannot infer — it is exactly inferable from how heavy the record is" — right as a paraphrase of §2 (its recordSurface example fails admission test 1 because field count is inferable). See ③ B3 for what the paraphrase steps around.
6. "The renderer uses this ONLY as the default and lets explicit config win: a view's form/navigation config, an assigned page, and the object's editMode" — right at the objectui pin: deriveRecordSurface is called by app-shell ObjectView.tsx :2657 under an authored activeView.navigation or objectDef.navigation (:2640-:2652, mode and size both honoured), by plugin-view ObjectView.tsx :1688 under schema.layout and a per-view navigation config (handleRowClick :1807-:1836), and by AppContent.tsx :635 for the post-create landing; deriveRecordFlowSurface by AppContent.tsx :1201-:1208 with the form view's layout spread after it (:1216); RecordDetailView.tsx :640-:652 lets an assigned page replace the synthesized one.
7. "editMode ('modal' | 'page', declared in object.zod.ts by commit f11fc61c5's maintainer ruling as edit-interaction intent, which the renderer applies; nothing in this file reads it)" — right on every clause: object.zod.ts :2915 is z.enum(['modal', 'page']), :2900 "Cross-renderer EDIT-INTERACTION intent", :2909 "Declared here by commit f11fc61c5's maintainer ruling" (the commit resolves in this repository: declare editMode on the object document); liveness/object.json props.editMode is live with the same consumer named; objectui at the pin: recordFormNavigation.ts :116 branches on objectDef.editMode !== 'page' and AppContent.tsx handleEdit :672-:684 navigates to the page target; in record-surface.ts the token editMode occurs at :22 and :161 only, both comment lines — the code reads def.fields (:70-:77, each field's hidden), opts.viewport, opts.pageThreshold and flow.

deriveRecordFlowSurface docblock, :157-:162 (ships):
8. "a DEFAULT only, read from def.fields, flow and opts and nothing else" — right (:169-:179; the base derivation at :95-:100 and countAuthorableFields at :68-:79).
9. "the renderer lets explicit config win over it — navigation.mode / navigation.size, FormView.type / modalSize, an assigned page, and the object's editMode (...; not read here)" — right that the function reads none of them, that editMode is named instead of excluded, and that the list is no longer called closed ("no new authorable key" is gone). navigation.mode / size: spec view.zod.ts :2372-:2377, applied in objectui as in item 6. editMode and an assigned page: items 6 and 7. The "FormView.type / modalSize" arm is carried verbatim from the old sentence and holds only in part at the pin — ③ B2.

The dispatch's hypothesis 1 ("the overrides the derivation itself defers to") was measured off by the dev and is off: the code defers to nothing; the text says the renderer lets explicit config win, which is what the code and the pin show, and the card's Target 1 allowed "whichever is true of the code".

### ② Semver level

`patch` for @objectstack/spec, the body carrying `Clause-②: no`, matches what ships: src/data/index.ts :349 re-exports record-surface, src/data/index.ts is a dts entry in tsup.config.ts, package.json ships dist and maps ./data to dist/data/index.d.ts and .d.mts, so the deriveRecordFlowSurface docblock (items 8-9) is published text. The file header is a free-standing block comment attached to no export, and record-surface.ts is not a `src/**/*.zod.ts` file, so it reaches no artefact (the dev's grep of dist agrees — the new function sentence in both d.ts flavours, the header heading in neither — and is not re-run here). A docblock-only change that publishes takes patch, never skip-changeset (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). No schema key added, widened or narrowed, so Clause-②: no is right, and the PR body and the changeset carry the same line. Check Changeset and Spec property liveness: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (report 6223669341), each answered:
- D1, a worktree on the pre-existing branch with the primary HEAD detached: process only; the net diff against merge-base fd0e72abc2 is the one commit judged above. Answered.
- D2, the header's "explicit control" sentence (:20-:24) rewritten beyond the claim's :4-:13: inside the file header the claim names, and it is the same omission (the sentence named only an assigned page). Judged as items 6 and 7. Answered.
- D3, package tests narrowed to record-surface.test.ts plus typecheck: comment-only diff; Test Core shards 1, 4, 5 and 6 of 6 are success on the head; 2 and 3 are still in progress at this read and this record has not read them. Answered, with that gap stated.
- D4, the model-free commit trailer pair: that is the pair AGENTS.md prescribes for an agent commit, and the head's trailer carries it with no model identifier. Not a deviation. Answered.
- open_questions: letter A (keep "the renderer lets explicit config win over it"). Letter B would state a read the code does not make. Answered: A.

Escalations to the seat:
- B1, the verdict's cause and this PR's to fix: item 4, the mobile-light create/edit cell. One phrase in an unshipped header; a push re-owes the record on the new head, since the file is the review surface.
- B2, not this PR's: the carried "FormView.type / modalSize" arm. At the objectui pin the console's create/edit modal pins formType 'modal' as the container (AppContent.tsx :1179, :1215) and resolveFormViewLayout (recordFormNavigation.ts :197-:218) carries sections, contentLayout for type 'tabbed' and subforms only — no modalSize — while ModalForm.tsx :464-:466 honours only the modalSize of the schema it is handed (an object-form page block's own key, component.zod.ts :6934, or an action dialog's size). So an authored FormView.modalSize (view.zod.ts :4459) does not reach the console's create/edit surface at the pin, and FormView.type changes that surface's layout, not its container. The old sentence shipped the same claim and the card did not question it. Candidate card for the objectui lane beside 6207254097 F1 / F2, or a narrowing of that fragment in a later docblock PR.
- B3, not this PR's: ADR-0085 §2 still names "a modal-vs-page presentation surface" as rejected at the object layer while object.zod.ts admits editMode by the f11fc61c5 ruling; the new header paraphrases §2 as "the size of the surface", which is §2's reasoning and avoids the literal clash. The card asked for no ADR edit and this record asks for none; noted so the spec seat knows the ADR text and the ruling are unreconciled.
- B4: the card's own out-of-scope pair stands (whether the derivation should read editMode; objectui ignoring the derived task-flow container and deriving the view surface without a viewport). Nothing new found.
- B5: the Docs Drift Check on this PR resolved no anchor for record-surface.ts; prose pages restating the override list or the per-flow rule (the skill page #23753 fixed is the known one) are not covered by this record either.

Reason for the verdict: one sentence of the rewritten header states the derivation wrongly for the mobile-light create/edit cell (item 4), and the card's acceptance 1 requires the header sentences to be true of the code as it stands. Everything else — the shipped override sentence, editMode's naming, "not read here", the patch changeset and Clause-②: no — holds. Fix the one phrase, push, and the record is re-owed on the new head.
